  • Constructor Details

    • CellStyleDocxPpt

      public CellStyleDocxPpt(String backgroundColor, String width)
      Represents the style of a Word/PowerPoint cell element. Use default value if you don't want to specify an optional argument.
      Parameters:
      backgroundColor - The background color of the cell (hex format). (Optional)
      width - The width of the cell + unit ( in, cm, px, pt, em and % (% is in respect to the initial width of the table)). Giving a width of 0 will remove the whole column.

    • CellStyleDocxPpt

      public CellStyleDocxPpt(String backgroundColor, String width, String preserveTotalWidthOfTable, String border, String borderTop, String borderBottom, String borderLeft, String borderRight, String borderDiagonalDown, String borderDiagonalUp, String borderColor, String borderTopColor, String borderBottomColor, String borderLeftColor, String borderRightColor, String borderDiagonalUpColor, String borderDiagonalDownColor, String borderSize, String borderTopSize, String borderBottomSize, String borderLeftSize, String borderRightSize, String borderDiagonalUpSize, String borderDiagonalDownSize, String borderSpace, String borderTopSpace, String borderBottomSpace, String borderLeftSpace, String borderRightSpace, String borderDiagonalUpSpace, String borderDiagonalDownSpace)
      Represents the style of a Word/PowerPoint cell element. Use default value if you don't want to specify an optional argument.
      Parameters:
      backgroundColor - The background color of the cell (hex format). (Optional)
      width - The width of the cell + unit ( in, cm, px, pt, em and % (% is in respect to the initial width of the table)). Giving a width of 0 will remove the whole column.
      preserveTotalWidthOfTable - Keeps table width constant by redistributing removed column's width to others..
      border - The border style applied to all edges (top, bottom, left, right) of the table. Optional.
      borderTop - The border style applied to the top edge of the table. Optional.
      borderBottom - The border style applied to the bottom edge of the table. Optional.
      borderLeft - The border style applied to the left edge of the table. Optional.
      borderRight - The border style applied to the right edge of the table. Optional.
      borderDiagonalDown - Applies the specified border style to the diagonal line going from the top-left to the bottom-right corner. Optional.
      borderDiagonalUp - Applies the specified border style to the diagonal line going from the bottom-left to the top-right corner. Optional.
      borderColor - The color of the borders (top, bottom, left, right). Optional.
      borderTopColor - The color of the top border. Optional.
      borderBottomColor - The color of the bottom border. Optional.
      borderLeftColor - The color of the left border. Optional.
      borderRightColor - The color of the right border. Optional.
      borderDiagonalUpColor - The color of the diagonal up border. Optional.
      borderDiagonalDownColor - The color of the diagonal down border. Optional.
      borderSize - The width of the borders (top, bottom, left, right) in points. Optional.
      borderTopSize - The width of the top border in points. Optional.
      borderBottomSize - The width of the bottom border in points. Optional.
      borderLeftSize - The width of the left border in points. Optional.
      borderRightSize - The width of the right border in points. Optional.
      borderDiagonalUpSize - The width of the diagonal up border in points. Optional.
      borderDiagonalDownSize - The width of the diagonal down border in points. Optional.
      borderSpace - The spacing between the content and borders in points. Optional.
      borderTopSpace - The spacing between the content and the top border. Optional.
      borderBottomSpace - The spacing between the content and the bottom border. Optional.
      borderLeftSpace - The spacing between the content and the left border. Optional.
      borderRightSpace - The spacing between the content and the right border in points Optional.
      borderDiagonalUpSpace - The spacing between the content and the diagonal up border in points. Optional.
      borderDiagonalDownSpace - The spacing between the content and the diagonal down border in points. Optional.
